question: No leave advance may be granted when the leave taken is less / more than 30 days.
A Government servant on extraordinary leave is entitled / not entitled to leave salary.
A Government servant on half pay leave or leave not due is entitled to leave salary equal to half / full the amount drawn immediately before proceeding on leave.
A Government servant who proceeds on earned leave is entitled / not entitled to leave salary equal to the pay drawn immediately before proceeding on earned leave.
A Government servant on commuted leave is entitled / not entitled to leave salary equal to the amount drawn before proceeding on leave.
